```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)

# 1. Dog Licensing
dog_lic <- read_csv("data/Dog_Licensing.csv")
cat("=== DOG LICENSE ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dog_lic), "Cols:", ncol(dog_lic), "\n")
glimpse(dog_lic)

# 2. Dog Bites
dog_bite <- read_csv("data/Dog_Bite.csv")
cat("\n=== DOG BITE ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(dog_bite), "Cols:", ncol(dog_bite), "\n")
glimpse(dog_bite)

# 3. Population by Community District
pop_cd <- read_csv("data/NYCity_Pop_By_CD.csv")
cat("\n=== POPULATION BY CD ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(pop_cd), "Cols:", ncol(pop_cd), "\n")
glimpse(pop_cd)

# 4. Income median
income <- read_xlsx("data/NYC_Income_Household_Median.xlsx")
cat("\n=== INCOME ===\n")
cat("Rows:", nrow(income), "Cols:", ncol(income), "\n")
glimpse(income)

# 5. Dog Runs
dog_runs <- read.csv("data/Dog_Runs.csv")
cat("\n=== DOG RUNS ===\n")
str(dog_runs, max.level = 2)
```

---

## Join Validation Plan

Once you see the column names, here's how all 5 datasets connect:
```
Dog_Licensing   (zipcode)  ──→  nyc_zips shapefile (ZCTA5CE20)
                                        ↑
Dog_Bite        (zipcode)  ──→  nyc_zips shapefile
                                        ↑
Dog_Runs        (lat/lon)  ──→  st_join() to nyc_zips polygons
                                        ↑
Income          (zipcode?) ──→  nyc_zips shapefile
                                        ↑
Population      (CD?)      ──→  ⚠️ May need borough bridge table
```


## Try to fix 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(jsonlite)
library(tigris)
library(sf)

# ── 1. DOG LICENSE (already clean from earlier) ──────────────────────────────
borough_lookup <- tibble(
  prefix = c("100","101","102","103","104","105","106",
             "107","108","109","110","111","113","114",
             "115","116","112","117","118","119"),
  borough = c("Manhattan","Manhattan","Manhattan","Staten Island",
              "Bronx","Bronx","Bronx","Bronx","Bronx","Bronx",
              "Queens","Queens","Queens","Queens","Queens","Queens",
              "Brooklyn","Staten Island","Staten Island","Staten Island")
)

dog_lic_clean <- dog_lic %>%
  filter(!is.na(zipcode)) %>%
  mutate(
    zipcode = as.character(as.integer(zipcode)),
    prefix  = str_sub(zipcode, 1, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(str_starts(zipcode,"10") | str_starts(zipcode,"11")) %>%
  left_join(borough_lookup, by = "prefix")

cat("Dog license clean rows:", nrow(dog_lic_clean), "\n")
table(dog_lic_clean$borough, useNA="always")

# ── 2. DOG BITE ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
dog_bite_clean <- dog_bite %>%
  mutate(
    year    = year(dateofbite),
    has_zip = !is.na(zipcode) & zipcode != "",
    zipcode = na_if(zipcode, "")
  ) %>%
  filter(borough %in% c("Bronx","Brooklyn","Manhattan","Queens","Staten Island"))

cat("Dog bite clean rows:", nrow(dog_bite_clean), "\n")
cat("Rows with zipcode:", sum(dog_bite_clean$has_zip), "\n")

# ── 3. INCOME — filter to NYC only ───────────────────────────────────────────
# First check column names
cat("\nIncome columns:\n")
print(names(income))

# Filter to NY state and NYC zipcodes only
income_nyc <- income %>%
  filter(state_id == "NY") %>%
  filter(str_starts(as.character(zip), "10") | 
         str_starts(as.character(zip), "11")) %>%
  mutate(zipcode = as.character(as.integer(zip)))

cat("Income NYC rows:", nrow(income_nyc), "\n")
glimpse(income_nyc)

# ── 4. DOG RUNS — parse JSON properly ────────────────────────────────────────
# Extract column names from meta
col_names <- map_chr(dog_runs$meta$view$columns, "fieldName")
cat("\nDog runs columns:\n")
print(col_names)

# Convert data matrix to dataframe
dog_runs_df <- as_tibble(
  dog_runs$data, .name_repair = "minimal"
) %>%
  setNames(col_names) %>%
  select(any_of(c("name","location_1","borough","park_borough",
                  "lat","lon","latitude","longitude","accessible")))

cat("Dog runs rows:", nrow(dog_runs_df), "\n")
glimpse(dog_runs_df)

# ── 5. NYC MAP via tigris (no download needed) ────────────────────────────────
options(tigris_use_cache = TRUE)

nyc_zips <- zctas(cb = TRUE, year = 2020) %>%
  filter(str_starts(ZCTA5CE20, "10") | str_starts(ZCTA5CE20, "11"))

cat("\nNYC zip polygons:", nrow(nyc_zips), "\n")
plot(st_geometry(nyc_zips), main = "NYC Zipcodes via tigris")
```

## 2nd clarify data
```{r}
# ── 1. FIX BOROUGH (rename to avoid conflict) ────────────────────
dog_lic_clean <- dog_lic %>%
  filter(!is.na(zipcode)) %>%
  mutate(
    zipcode = as.character(as.integer(zipcode)),
    prefix  = str_sub(zipcode, 1, 3)
  ) %>%
  filter(str_starts(zipcode,"10") | str_starts(zipcode,"11")) %>%
  select(-any_of("borough")) %>%
  left_join(borough_lookup, by = "prefix")

table(dog_lic_clean$borough, useNA="always")

# ── 2. CHECK INCOME — no income column, just population/density ──
# This dataset has NO median income — just population & density
# It's from simplemaps base (free tier has no income)
# Use population + density for normalisation only
# You need a different source for actual income

# Quick check what we DO have:
income_nyc %>% select(zipcode, population, density) %>% head(5)

# ── 3. FIX DOG RUNS JSON ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Check actual structure
cat("Dog runs data class:", class(dog_runs$data), "\n")
cat("Meta columns type:", class(dog_runs$meta$view$columns), "\n")

# Try direct extraction
if(is.data.frame(dog_runs$data)) {
  dog_runs_df <- as_tibble(dog_runs$data)
} else {
  # It's a matrix — extract differently
  dog_runs_raw <- as_tibble(
    as.data.frame(dog_runs$data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  )
  cat("Dog runs raw cols:", ncol(dog_runs_raw), "\n")
  print(head(dog_runs_raw, 2))
}

# Also try simpler approach — re-read with flatten
dog_runs2 <- fromJSON("data/Dog_Runs.json", flatten = TRUE)
cat("\nDog runs2 names:\n")
print(names(dog_runs2))
```


### find Median income in the NYC via API

```{r}
library(tidycensus)
census_api_key("d43934f52489c25471f4f6e0942464d34a9052a8", install = TRUE, overwrite = TRUE)

readRenviron("~/.Renviron")

income_acs <- get_acs(
+     geography = "zcta",
+     variables = c(
+         median_income   = "B19013_001",  # median household income
+         total_pop       = "B01003_001"   # total population
+     ),
+     year = 2022, # year can determin later
+     output = "wide"
+ ) %>%
+     filter(
+         str_starts(GEOID, "10") | str_starts(GEOID, "11")
+     ) %>%
+     rename(zipcode = GEOID) %>%
+     select(zipcode, median_income = median_incomeE, 
+            total_pop = total_popE)
```

## Final test

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

# ── DOG RUNS: decode borough + extract coordinates ───────────────
dr <- read.csv("data/Dog_Runs.csv")
```

```{r}
dog_runs_clean <- dr %>%
  filter(FEATURESTATUS == "Active") %>%
  mutate(
    borough = case_when(
      BOROUGH == "M" ~ "Manhattan",
      BOROUGH == "B" ~ "Brooklyn",
      BOROUGH == "Q" ~ "Queens",
      BOROUGH == "X" ~ "Bronx",
      BOROUGH == "R" ~ "Staten Island",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    zipcode = na_if(ZIPCODE, "")
  ) %>%
  select(name = NAME, borough, zipcode,
         dog_area_type = DOG_AREA_TYPE,
         surface = SURFACE, seating = SEATING,
         the_geom)

cat("Active dog runs:", nrow(dog_runs_clean), "\n")
table(dog_runs_clean$borough, useNA = "always")

# ── VALIDATE ALL JOINS ────────────────────────────────────────────
# Aggregate dogs per zipcode
dogs_per_zip <- dog_lic_clean %>%
  count(zipcode, name = "total_dogs")

# Bites per zipcode
bites_per_zip <- dog_bite_clean %>%
  filter(has_zip) %>%
  count(zipcode, name = "total_bites")

# Dog runs per zipcode
runs_per_zip <- dog_runs_clean %>%
  filter(!is.na(zipcode)) %>%
  count(zipcode, name = "dog_runs_count")

# ── MASTER JOIN ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
master <- dogs_per_zip %>%
  left_join(bites_per_zip,  by = "zipcode") %>%
  left_join(runs_per_zip,   by = "zipcode") %>%
  left_join(
    income_acs %>% select(zipcode, median_income, total_pop),
    by = "zipcode"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    dogs_per_1000 = (total_dogs / total_pop) * 1000,
    bites_per_1000_dogs = (total_bites / total_dogs) * 1000,
    has_dog_run = !is.na(dog_runs_count)
  )

cat("\nMaster table rows:", nrow(master), "\n")
cat("Missing income:", sum(is.na(master$median_income)), "\n")
cat("Missing bites:", sum(is.na(master$total_bites)), "\n")
cat("Missing dog runs:", sum(is.na(master$dog_runs_count)), "\n")

# ── JOIN TO SHAPEFILE ─────────────────────────────────────────────
nyc_map_final <- nyc_zips %>%
  left_join(master, by = c("ZCTA5CE20" = "zipcode"))

cat("\nFinal map rows:", nrow(nyc_map_final), "\n")
cat("Map NAs (no dog data):", 
    sum(is.na(nyc_map_final$total_dogs)), "\n")

# ── QUICK PREVIEW MAP ─────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(nyc_map_final) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = dogs_per_1000), color = "white", size = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(na.value = "grey90", name = "Dogs\nper 1000\nresidents") +
  labs(title = "NYC Dog Ownership Density by Zipcode",
       subtitle = "Registered dogs per 1,000 residents") +
  theme_void()
```
